query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('product_id',r.source_id,'need',r.target_id,'source',r.data->'source','confidence',r.data->'confidence') AS "need!" FROM knowledge_relations r JOIN products p ON p.tenant=r.tenant AND p.id=r.source_id WHERE r.tenant=$1 AND r.kind='SERVES' ORDER BY r.source_id,r.target_id LIMIT 48
